australia-2026-doc-9-mclaren-floor-1.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Floor","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Revised floor geometry","New floor edge geometry, resulting in better flow control around the rear tyres aiming at improved floor and rear corner aerodynamic load.","Floor | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Revised floor geometry | New floor edge geometry, resulting in better flow control around the rear tyres aiming at improved floor and rear corner aerodynamic load."]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría revisada del piso
es.briefDescription: Nueva geometría del borde del piso, que mejora el control del flujo alrededor de los neumáticos traseros con el objetivo de mejorar la carga aerodinámica del piso y del conjunto trasero.

australia-2026-doc-9-mclaren-rear-suspen.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Suspension","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Updated Rear Suspension Fairing","New fairing around the Rear Suspension mounting points resulting in improved flow conditioning around the Rear impact structure aiming at improved diffuser performance.","Rear Suspension | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Updated Rear Suspension Fairing | New fairing around the Rear Suspension mounting points resulting in improved flow conditioning around the Rear impact structure aiming at improved diffuser performance."]

es.geometricDifference: Carenado actualizado de la suspensión trasera
es.briefDescription: Nuevo carenado alrededor de los puntos de anclaje de la suspensión trasera que mejora el acondicionamiento del flujo alrededor de la estructura de impacto trasera con el objetivo de mejorar el rendimiento del difusor.

australia-2026-doc-9-mclaren-rear-wing-3.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Wing","Performance – Local Load","New Rear Wing","A new Rear Wing geometry featuring revised mainplane and flap elements, gaining aerodynamic load throughout all conditions while maintaining efficiency.","Rear Wing | Performance – Local Load | New Rear Wing | A new Rear Wing geometry featuring revised mainplane and flap elements, gaining aerodynamic load throughout all conditions while maintaining efficiency."]

es.geometricDifference: Nuevo alerón trasero
es.briefDescription: Nueva geometría del alerón trasero con elementos del plano principal y del flap revisados, que gana carga aerodinámica en todas las condiciones manteniendo la eficiencia.

australia-2026-doc-9-mercedes-bodywork-1.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Bodywork","Performance – Local Load","Compared to the 2026 starting point, the R01 bodywork is more downwash in sideview, with a high inlet.","Down-washing the bodywork pulls high energy flow down onto the rear of the car. The high inlet increases the stream tube to the rear floor.","Bodywork | Performance – Local Load | Compared to the 2026 starting point, the R01 bodywork is more downwash in sideview, with a high inlet. | Down-washing the bodywork pulls high energy flow down onto the rear of the car. The high inlet increases the stream tube to the rear floor."]

es.geometricDifference: En comparación con el punto de partida de 2026, la carrocería R01 dirige más el flujo hacia abajo en la vista lateral, con una entrada alta.
es.briefDescription: La carrocería que dirige el flujo hacia abajo lleva flujo de alta energía hacia la parte trasera del coche. La entrada alta aumenta el tubo de corriente hacia la parte trasera del piso.

australia-2026-doc-9-mercedes-front-wing.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing","Performance – Local Load","Compared to the 2026 starting point, the R01 front wing has increased camber and no strake.","Increasing element chamber increases the front wing load, with the spanwise loading chosen to optimise the onset flow to the floor.","Front Wing | Performance – Local Load | Compared to the 2026 starting point, the R01 front wing has increased camber and no strake. | Increasing element chamber increases the front wing load, with the spanwise loading chosen to optimise the onset flow to the floor."]

es.geometricDifference: En comparación con el punto de partida de 2026, el alerón delantero R01 tiene mayor curvatura y carece de aleta longitudinal.
es.briefDescription: El aumento de la curvatura del elemento aumenta la carga del alerón delantero, con una distribución de carga a lo largo de la envergadura elegida para optimizar el flujo incidente sobre el piso.

australia-2026-doc-9-mercedes-rear-wing-.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Wing","Performance – Local Load","Compared to the 2026 starting point, the R01 rear wing has increased camber.","Increased rear wing camber to increase wing load, with the chord of the elements optimised to find the right balance between SLM closed Cz and SLM open Cx.","Rear Wing | Performance – Local Load | Compared to the 2026 starting point, the R01 rear wing has increased camber. | Increased rear wing camber to increase wing load, with the chord of the elements optimised to find the right balance between SLM closed Cz and SLM open Cx."]

es.geometricDifference: En comparación con el punto de partida de 2026, el alerón trasero R01 tiene mayor curvatura.
es.briefDescription: Mayor curvatura del alerón trasero para aumentar la carga del alerón, con la cuerda de los elementos optimizada para encontrar el equilibrio adecuado entre el Cz con SLM cerrado y el Cx con SLM abierto.

australia-2026-doc-9-red-bull-racing-fro.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing","Performance - Local Load","Revised to comply with 2026 regulations.","Up to 3 elements for 2026 by regulation, with allowance to attach at either first or second element with those rearward able to move for balance and SM drag reduction. The ORBR design attaches at the first element allowing both flaps to perform the SM/CM change.","Front Wing | Performance - Local Load | Revised to comply with 2026 regulations. | Up to 3 elements for 2026 by regulation, with allowance to attach at either first or second element with those rearward able to move for balance and SM drag reduction. The ORBR design attaches at the first element allowing both flaps to perform the SM/CM change."]

es.geometricDifference: Revisado para cumplir el reglamento de 2026.
es.briefDescription: El reglamento permite hasta 3 elementos en 2026, con posibilidad de fijación al primer o segundo elemento y de movimiento de los elementos posteriores para el equilibrio y la reducción de resistencia en SM. El diseño de ORBR se fija al primer elemento, permitiendo que ambos flaps realicen el cambio SM/CM.

australia-2026-doc-9-red-bull-racing-nos.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Nose","Performance - Local Load","Revised to comply with 2026 regulations.","Nose profile revised by regulation and the need for SM actuation of the front wing flap or flaps with concurrent or separate balance adjusters. ORBR design places all the adjustments within the nosebox.","Nose | Performance - Local Load | Revised to comply with 2026 regulations. | Nose profile revised by regulation and the need for SM actuation of the front wing flap or flaps with concurrent or separate balance adjusters. ORBR design places all the adjustments within the nosebox."]

es.geometricDifference: Revisado para cumplir el reglamento de 2026.
es.briefDescription: Perfil de la nariz revisado por el reglamento y por la necesidad de accionar en SM el flap o los flaps del alerón delantero, con ajustadores de equilibrio simultáneos o separados. El diseño de ORBR sitúa todos los ajustes dentro de la caja de la nariz.

australia-2026-doc-9-red-bull-racing-rea.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","Revised to comply with 2026 regulations.","Mandated to be supported on two pylons intersecting the underside of the mainplane. One or two element flap assembly actuating to engage SM and reduce drag. Chord length of the mainplane is to team design and the endplates have returned to be perpendicular panels at the ends of the elements. ORBR design places the actuator on centreline.","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | Revised to comply with 2026 regulations. | Mandated to be supported on two pylons intersecting the underside of the mainplane. One or two element flap assembly actuating to engage SM and reduce drag. Chord length of the mainplane is to team design and the endplates have returned to be perpendicular panels at the ends of the elements. ORBR design places the actuator on centreline."]

es.geometricDifference: Revisado para cumplir el reglamento de 2026.
es.briefDescription: Debe apoyarse en dos pilares que intersectan la cara inferior del plano principal. Un conjunto de flaps de uno o dos elementos se acciona para activar SM y reducir la resistencia. La longitud de cuerda del plano principal depende del diseño del equipo, y las placas laterales vuelven a ser paneles perpendiculares en los extremos de los elementos. El diseño de ORBR sitúa el actuador en la línea central.

australia-2026-doc-9-ferrari-front-wing-.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Narrower span / longer chord front wing with SM system integration","A significant geometrical difference compared to previous generation of cars is the front wing. Design focus has been on optimizing balance range and aerodynamic characteristics around the new 2026 regulations, whilst properly integrating the newly introduced SM system, with a centerline actuator solution retained for us and that rotates the 2 flap elements together","Front Wing | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Narrower span / longer chord front wing with SM system integration | A significant geometrical difference compared to previous generation of cars is the front wing. Design focus has been on optimizing balance range and aerodynamic characteristics around the new 2026 regulations, whilst properly integrating the newly introduced SM system, with a centerline actuator solution retained for us and that rotates the 2 flap elements together"]

es.geometricDifference: Alerón delantero de menor envergadura / mayor cuerda con integración del sistema SM
es.briefDescription: Una diferencia geométrica significativa respecto a la generación anterior de coches es el alerón delantero. El diseño se ha centrado en optimizar el rango de equilibrio y las características aerodinámicas bajo el nuevo reglamento de 2026, integrando correctamente el sistema SM recién introducido, con una solución de actuador en la línea central que hemos conservado y que gira conjuntamente los 2 elementos de flap

australia-2026-doc-9-ferrari-floor-2.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Floor Body / Diffuser","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Reduced floor dimensions and simplified underbody","The transition between 2025 and 2026 represents a significant shift in underfloor aerodynamic philosophy. By making the floor flatter and with less authority on front vortical structures as well as the removal of complex floor edges, the main development focus has been on understanding how to extract maximum performance across the entire car operating envelope","Floor Body / Diffuser | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Reduced floor dimensions and simplified underbody | The transition between 2025 and 2026 represents a significant shift in underfloor aerodynamic philosophy. By making the floor flatter and with less authority on front vortical structures as well as the removal of complex floor edges, the main development focus has been on understanding how to extract maximum performance across the entire car operating envelope"]

es.geometricDifference: Dimensiones reducidas del piso y zona inferior de la carrocería simplificada
es.briefDescription: La transición entre 2025 y 2026 representa un cambio significativo en la filosofía aerodinámica de la zona inferior del coche. Al hacer el piso más plano y con menor autoridad sobre las estructuras vorticosas delanteras, y eliminar los bordes complejos del piso, el desarrollo se ha centrado en comprender cómo extraer el máximo rendimiento en todo el rango de funcionamiento del coche

australia-2026-doc-9-ferrari-rear-wing-3.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Wing","Performance – Local load","Three-element active rear wing","Key aspect for this new era has been on developing a top rear wing solution around a three-element arrangement without relying on interactions with the lower beam wing, which was a dominant factor with the 2025 topology. Given the importance of SM mode in 2026, maximizing SM effect has been a point of focus","Rear Wing | Performance – Local load | Three-element active rear wing | Key aspect for this new era has been on developing a top rear wing solution around a three-element arrangement without relying on interactions with the lower beam wing, which was a dominant factor with the 2025 topology. Given the importance of SM mode in 2026, maximizing SM effect has been a point of focus"]

es.geometricDifference: Alerón trasero activo de tres elementos
es.briefDescription: Un aspecto clave de esta nueva era ha sido desarrollar una solución de alerón trasero superior con una disposición de tres elementos sin depender de las interacciones con el ala inferior, que era un factor dominante en la configuración de 2025. Dada la importancia del modo SM en 2026, maximizar su efecto ha sido un punto central de trabajo

australia-2026-doc-9-racing-bulls-floor-.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Floor Body","Performance – Flow Conditioning","Updated keel, floor leading edge devices, and rear floor.","The updated forward floor components improve the flow quality under the floor, allowing the floor to generate more downforce.","Floor Body | Performance – Flow Conditioning | Updated keel, floor leading edge devices, and rear floor. | The updated forward floor components improve the flow quality under the floor, allowing the floor to generate more downforce."]

es.geometricDifference: Quilla, dispositivos del borde de ataque del piso y parte trasera del piso actualizados.
es.briefDescription: Los componentes delanteros del piso actualizados mejoran la calidad del flujo bajo el piso, permitiendo que éste genere más carga aerodinámica.

australia-2026-doc-9-racing-bulls-engine.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Coke/Engine Cover","Performance – Flow Conditioning","The top deck of the engine cover has been reshaped.","Airflow to the rear of the car is improved by modifying the flowfield around the bodywork, allowing the rear wing to work more effectively.","Coke/Engine Cover | Performance – Flow Conditioning | The top deck of the engine cover has been reshaped. | Airflow to the rear of the car is improved by modifying the flowfield around the bodywork, allowing the rear wing to work more effectively."]

es.componentName: Zona de estrechamiento trasero / Cubierta del motor
es.geometricDifference: Se ha modificado la forma de la superficie superior de la cubierta del motor.
es.briefDescription: El flujo hacia la parte trasera del coche mejora al modificar el campo de flujo alrededor de la carrocería, permitiendo que el alerón trasero trabaje con mayor eficacia.

australia-2026-doc-9-racing-bulls-coolin.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Cooling Louvres","Circuit specific - Cooling Range","Additional configurations of cooling louvres, with increased & decreased openings.","Opening or closing the louvres in the bodywork allows the cooling level for the engine to be tuned to the circuit conditions.","Cooling Louvres | Circuit specific - Cooling Range | Additional configurations of cooling louvres, with increased & decreased openings. | Opening or closing the louvres in the bodywork allows the cooling level for the engine to be tuned to the circuit conditions."]

es.primaryReason: Específico del circuito - Rango de refrigeración
es.geometricDifference: Configuraciones adicionales de branquias de refrigeración, con aperturas mayores y menores.
es.briefDescription: Abrir o cerrar las branquias de la carrocería permite ajustar el nivel de refrigeración del motor a las condiciones del circuito.

australia-2026-doc-9-racing-bulls-rear-c.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Corner","Performance - Local Load","The geometry of the winglets on the rear corner has been updated.","Additional downforce is generated on the rear corner by the winglets around the suspension, at an efficiency suitable for the circuit characteristics.","Rear Corner | Performance - Local Load | The geometry of the winglets on the rear corner has been updated. | Additional downforce is generated on the rear corner by the winglets around the suspension, at an efficiency suitable for the circuit characteristics."]

es.geometricDifference: Se ha actualizado la geometría de los aletines del conjunto trasero.
es.briefDescription: Los aletines alrededor de la suspensión generan carga aerodinámica adicional en el conjunto trasero, con una eficiencia adecuada a las características del circuito.

australia-2026-doc-9-aston-martin-front-.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing","Performance - Local Load","Three element narrow front wing. The wing is mounted to the nose from the second element. SM is achieved with a moveable third element.","The front wing optimises spanwise loading whilst delivering the required aerobalance range, which is achieved varying incidence of the rear element.","Front Wing | Performance - Local Load | Three element narrow front wing. The wing is mounted to the nose from the second element. SM is achieved with a moveable third element. | The front wing optimises spanwise loading whilst delivering the required aerobalance range, which is achieved varying incidence of the rear element."]

es.geometricDifference: Alerón delantero estrecho de tres elementos. El alerón se monta en la nariz por el segundo elemento. El modo SM se obtiene con un tercer elemento móvil.
es.briefDescription: El alerón delantero optimiza la distribución de carga a lo largo de la envergadura y proporciona el rango de equilibrio aerodinámico requerido, que se consigue variando la incidencia del elemento posterior.

australia-2026-doc-9-aston-martin-front-.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing Endplate","Performance - Flow Conditioning","The front wing endplate includes a diveplane on the outboard side and an OB foot with a channel on the lower surface.","The front wing endplate manages the circulation at the tip of the wing and positions downstream features around the front tyre.","Front Wing Endplate | Performance - Flow Conditioning | The front wing endplate includes a diveplane on the outboard side and an OB foot with a channel on the lower surface. | The front wing endplate manages the circulation at the tip of the wing and positions downstream features around the front tyre."]

es.geometricDifference: La placa lateral del alerón delantero incluye un aletín en el lado exterior y un pie exterior con un canal en la superficie inferior.
es.briefDescription: La placa lateral del alerón delantero gestiona la circulación en el extremo del alerón y sitúa las estructuras posteriores del flujo alrededor del neumático delantero.

australia-2026-doc-9-aston-martin-nose-3.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Nose","Performance - Local Load","The nose is higher and now separated from the front wing elements. Pylons are attached to the nose the front wing from which the front wing is mounted.","The volume of the nose is created to guide the upstream flow around the central front wing elements and manage the upwash from the wing.","Nose | Performance - Local Load | The nose is higher and now separated from the front wing elements. Pylons are attached to the nose the front wing from which the front wing is mounted. | The volume of the nose is created to guide the upstream flow around the central front wing elements and manage the upwash from the wing."]

es.geometricDifference: La nariz es más alta y ahora está separada de los elementos del alerón delantero. Los pilares se fijan a la nariz y al alerón delantero, desde los cuales se monta el alerón delantero.
es.briefDescription: El volumen de la nariz se crea para guiar el flujo incidente alrededor de los elementos centrales del alerón delantero y gestionar el flujo ascendente procedente del alerón.

australia-2026-doc-9-aston-martin-sidepo.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Sidepod Inlet","Performance - Flow Conditioning","The sidepod inlet is high and predominantly facing upwards. This creates a large undercut volume underneath that leads into the rest of the bodywork.","The inlet is sized to capture the massflow required to provide sufficient cooling. Externally flow is managed to the coke and deck.","Sidepod Inlet | Performance - Flow Conditioning | The sidepod inlet is high and predominantly facing upwards. This creates a large undercut volume underneath that leads into the rest of the bodywork. | The inlet is sized to capture the massflow required to provide sufficient cooling. Externally flow is managed to the coke and deck."]

es.geometricDifference: La entrada del pontón es alta y está orientada principalmente hacia arriba. Esto crea un gran volumen rebajado por debajo que continúa hacia el resto de la carrocería.
es.briefDescription: La entrada se dimensiona para captar el caudal másico necesario para proporcionar refrigeración suficiente. Externamente, el flujo se gestiona hacia la zona de estrechamiento trasero y la superficie superior.

australia-2026-doc-9-aston-martin-engine.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Coke/Engine Cover","Performance - Local Load","The large undercut from the sidepod is continued to the rear of the car. The top deck slopes down towards the rear of the car, with cooling exits more centrally on the engine cover.","The purpose of the bodywork is to manage flow from the new front end regulations.","Coke/Engine Cover | Performance - Local Load | The large undercut from the sidepod is continued to the rear of the car. The top deck slopes down towards the rear of the car, with cooling exits more centrally on the engine cover. | The purpose of the bodywork is to manage flow from the new front end regulations."]

es.componentName: Zona de estrechamiento trasero / Cubierta del motor
es.geometricDifference: El gran rebaje inferior del pontón continúa hasta la parte trasera del coche. La superficie superior desciende hacia la parte trasera del coche, con salidas de refrigeración más centradas en la cubierta del motor.
es.briefDescription: El objetivo de la carrocería es gestionar el flujo derivado del nuevo reglamento de la parte delantera.

australia-2026-doc-9-aston-martin-diffus.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Diffuser","Performance - Local Load","The diffuser extends rearward from the flat floor and carries the diffuser winglet defined by the regulations. A single fence is positioned within the diffuser.","The purpose of the diffuser is to manage the expansion of the flow from beneath the floor creating load on the lower surface. The winglet is adapted to the local flowfield to maximise performance.","Diffuser | Performance - Local Load | The diffuser extends rearward from the flat floor and carries the diffuser winglet defined by the regulations. A single fence is positioned within the diffuser. | The purpose of the diffuser is to manage the expansion of the flow from beneath the floor creating load on the lower surface. The winglet is adapted to the local flowfield to maximise performance."]

es.geometricDifference: El difusor se extiende hacia atrás desde el piso plano y lleva el aletín del difusor definido por el reglamento. Hay un único deflector dentro del difusor.
es.briefDescription: El objetivo del difusor es gestionar la expansión del flujo procedente de debajo del piso, creando carga en la superficie inferior. El aletín se adapta al campo de flujo local para maximizar el rendimiento.

australia-2026-doc-9-aston-martin-rear-w.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","Three element rear wing with the pylons mounted to the lower surface of the first element. The rwd two elements are activated in SM mode, reducing their incidence.","In CM the rear wing is optimised to provide maximum load while remaining stable and consistent. The SM deployment angle is defined to reduce drag as much as possible.","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | Three element rear wing with the pylons mounted to the lower surface of the first element. The rwd two elements are activated in SM mode, reducing their incidence. | In CM the rear wing is optimised to provide maximum load while remaining stable and consistent. The SM deployment angle is defined to reduce drag as much as possible."]

es.geometricDifference: Alerón trasero de tres elementos con los pilares montados en la superficie inferior del primer elemento. Los dos elementos posteriores se activan en modo SM, reduciendo su incidencia.
es.briefDescription: En CM, el alerón trasero se optimiza para proporcionar la máxima carga y permanecer estable y consistente. El ángulo de despliegue en SM se define para reducir la resistencia todo lo posible.

australia-2026-doc-9-haas-front-wing-1.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing","Performance - Local Load","The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the Front Wings","Haas features a three-element wing. The newly introduced SM Adjuster is positioned on the centerline beneath the nose and actuates both flap elements. The geometries have been optimized to deliver high load in Corner Mode and reduced drag in Straight Mode.","Front Wing | Performance - Local Load | The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the Front Wings | Haas features a three-element wing. The newly introduced SM Adjuster is positioned on the centerline beneath the nose and actuates both flap elements. The geometries have been optimized to deliver high load in Corner Mode and reduced drag in Straight Mode."]

es.geometricDifference: El Reglamento Técnico de 2026 introduce una disposición revisada de los alerones delanteros
es.briefDescription: Haas utiliza un alerón de tres elementos. El ajustador SM recién introducido se sitúa en la línea central, bajo la nariz, y acciona ambos elementos de flap. Las geometrías se han optimizado para proporcionar alta carga en Corner Mode y menor resistencia en Straight Mode.

australia-2026-doc-9-haas-front-wing-2.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing Endplate","Performance - Flow Conditioning","The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the Front Wing Endplates.","The endplate is engineered for optimal tyre-wake control, incorporating a high-mounted diveplane and a channelled footplate to enhance local flow conditioning and improve downstream aerodynamic flow.","Front Wing Endplate | Performance - Flow Conditioning | The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the Front Wing Endplates. | The endplate is engineered for optimal tyre-wake control, incorporating a high-mounted diveplane and a channelled footplate to enhance local flow conditioning and improve downstream aerodynamic flow."]

es.geometricDifference: El Reglamento Técnico de 2026 introduce una disposición revisada de las placas laterales del alerón delantero.
es.briefDescription: La placa lateral está diseñada para controlar de forma óptima la estela del neumático, incorporando un aletín situado en posición alta y un pie canalizado para mejorar el acondicionamiento local del flujo y el flujo aerodinámico posterior.

australia-2026-doc-9-haas-floor-3.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Floor Body","Performance - Local Load","The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the Floor.","The 2026 floor architecture features a predominantly flat underbody, with only a limited allowance for front inboard devices and a floorboard as defined by the regulations. Our geometry incorporates a substantial vertical vane to condition and manage the tyre-wake structures, complemented by a series of horizontal aerofoils that promote localised load extraction. This combination enhances vortex stability, preserves floor sealing, and improves the underfloor mass-flow distribution.","Floor Body | Performance - Local Load | The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the Floor. | The 2026 floor architecture features a predominantly flat underbody, with only a limited allowance for front inboard devices and a floorboard as defined by the regulations. Our geometry incorporates a substantial vertical vane to condition and manage the tyre-wake structures, complemented by a series of horizontal aerofoils that promote localised load extraction. This combination enhances vortex stability, preserves floor sealing, and improves the underfloor mass-flow distribution."]

es.geometricDifference: El Reglamento Técnico de 2026 introduce una disposición revisada del piso.
es.briefDescription: La arquitectura del piso de 2026 presenta una zona inferior predominantemente plana, con un margen limitado para dispositivos delanteros interiores y un panel del piso definido por el reglamento. Nuestra geometría incorpora una aleta vertical de gran tamaño para acondicionar y gestionar las estructuras de la estela del neumático, complementada con una serie de perfiles aerodinámicos horizontales que favorecen la extracción de carga local. Esta combinación mejora la estabilidad de los vórtices, conserva el sellado del piso y mejora la distribución del caudal másico bajo el piso.

australia-2026-doc-9-haas-floor-4.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Floor Edge","Performance - Flow Conditioning","The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the Floor Edge.","The floor edge incorporates a multi-slot geometry combined with an upper fence, engineered to mitigate tyre-contact-patch–induced pressure losses and reinforce the robustness of the floor’s sealing vortex system. This configuration enhances shear-layer stability, preserves underfloor mass-flow continuity, and reduces the susceptibility of the diffuser to wake-related load drop-off.","Floor Edge | Performance - Flow Conditioning | The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the Floor Edge. | The floor edge incorporates a multi-slot geometry combined with an upper fence, engineered to mitigate tyre-contact-patch–induced pressure losses and reinforce the robustness of the floor’s sealing vortex system. This configuration enhances shear-layer stability, preserves underfloor mass-flow continuity, and reduces the susceptibility of the diffuser to wake-related load drop-off."]

es.geometricDifference: El Reglamento Técnico de 2026 introduce una disposición revisada del borde del piso.
es.briefDescription: El borde del piso incorpora una geometría de múltiples ranuras combinada con un deflector superior, diseñada para mitigar las pérdidas de presión inducidas por la huella de contacto del neumático y reforzar la robustez del sistema de vórtices de sellado del piso. Esta configuración mejora la estabilidad de la capa de cizalladura, conserva la continuidad del caudal másico bajo el piso y reduce la susceptibilidad del difusor a la pérdida de carga relacionada con la estela.

australia-2026-doc-9-haas-diffuser-5.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Diffuser","Performance - Local Load","The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the diffuser geometry.","The 2026 diffuser incorporates a single primary fence per side, while the FIA-mandated outboard devices—previously mounted to the rear corner assemblies up to 2025—are now integrated directly into the outboard diffuser structure. The central expansion volume extends laterally alongside the rear impact structure, maximising underfloor mass-flow extraction and enhancing the diffuser’s overall pressure-recovery efficiency.","Diffuser | Performance - Local Load | The 2026 Technical Regulations introduce a revised layout for the diffuser geometry. | The 2026 diffuser incorporates a single primary fence per side, while the FIA-mandated outboard devices—previously mounted to the rear corner assemblies up to 2025—are now integrated directly into the outboard diffuser structure. The central expansion volume extends laterally alongside the rear impact structure, maximising underfloor mass-flow extraction and enhancing the diffuser’s overall pressure-recovery efficiency."]

es.geometricDifference: El Reglamento Técnico de 2026 introduce una disposición revisada de la geometría del difusor.
es.briefDescription: El difusor de 2026 incorpora un único deflector principal por lado, mientras que los dispositivos exteriores exigidos por la FIA —montados anteriormente en los conjuntos traseros hasta 2025— se integran ahora directamente en la estructura exterior del difusor. El volumen central de expansión se extiende lateralmente junto a la estructura de impacto trasera, maximizando la extracción del caudal másico bajo el piso y mejorando la eficiencia global de recuperación de presión del difusor.

australia-2026-doc-9-haas-rear-wing-6.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","The 2026 Technical Regulations allow for a three ‑ element upper Rear Wing configuration within a reduced legality volume compared to previous seasons.","Haas employs a three-element upper rear-wing assembly, with the SM mechanism providing simultaneous actuation of both flap elements. The mainplane is configured with a relatively low camber, while the flap cluster adopts an aggressive geometry to maximise downforce generation in Corner Mode (CM). In Straight Mode (SM), the system targets a substantial drag reduction by unloading the flap pair and exploiting the flat mainplane to minimise pressure-drag contribution","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | The 2026 Technical Regulations allow for a three ‑ element upper Rear Wing configuration within a reduced legality volume compared to previous seasons. | Haas employs a three-element upper rear-wing assembly, with the SM mechanism providing simultaneous actuation of both flap elements. The mainplane is configured with a relatively low camber, while the flap cluster adopts an aggressive geometry to maximise downforce generation in Corner Mode (CM). In Straight Mode (SM), the system targets a substantial drag reduction by unloading the flap pair and exploiting the flat mainplane to minimise pressure-drag contribution"]

es.geometricDifference: El Reglamento Técnico de 2026 permite una configuración de alerón trasero superior de tres elementos dentro de un volumen reglamentario reducido respecto a temporadas anteriores.
es.briefDescription: Haas utiliza un conjunto de alerón trasero superior de tres elementos, con un mecanismo SM que acciona simultáneamente ambos elementos de flap. El plano principal tiene una curvatura relativamente baja, mientras que el conjunto de flaps adopta una geometría agresiva para maximizar la generación de carga aerodinámica en Corner Mode (CM). En Straight Mode (SM), el sistema busca una reducción sustancial de la resistencia descargando el par de flaps y aprovechando el plano principal plano para minimizar la contribución de la resistencia de presión

australia-2026-doc-9-haas-beam-wing-7.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Beam Wing","Performance - Local Load","The 2026 Technical Regulations allow only a simplified lower-wing element.","The 2026 rear-structure geometry is deliberately simplified in compliance with the regulatory constraints. The beam wing is aligned with the incoming flow and functions primarily as a structural and aerodynamic interface, supporting both the floor assembly and the upper rear-wing system.","Beam Wing | Performance - Local Load | The 2026 Technical Regulations allow only a simplified lower-wing element. | The 2026 rear-structure geometry is deliberately simplified in compliance with the regulatory constraints. The beam wing is aligned with the incoming flow and functions primarily as a structural and aerodynamic interface, supporting both the floor assembly and the upper rear-wing system."]

es.geometricDifference: El Reglamento Técnico de 2026 sólo permite un elemento de ala inferior simplificado.
es.briefDescription: La geometría de la estructura trasera de 2026 se simplifica deliberadamente para cumplir las restricciones reglamentarias. El ala inferior se alinea con el flujo incidente y funciona principalmente como interfaz estructural y aerodinámica, dando soporte tanto al conjunto del piso como al sistema de alerón trasero superior.

australia-2026-doc-9-alpine-front-wing-1.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing","Performance - Local Load","Complete new front wing design in accordance with the 2026 regulations","The front wing has been completely redesigned to tackle the challenge of the new regulations. Its objective remains to produce load in Corner Mode, but also ensure drag is reduced at higher speeds, on the straights when in Straight Mode.","Front Wing | Performance - Local Load | Complete new front wing design in accordance with the 2026 regulations | The front wing has been completely redesigned to tackle the challenge of the new regulations. Its objective remains to produce load in Corner Mode, but also ensure drag is reduced at higher speeds, on the straights when in Straight Mode."]

es.geometricDifference: Diseño completamente nuevo del alerón delantero conforme al reglamento de 2026
es.briefDescription: El alerón delantero se ha rediseñado por completo para afrontar el desafío del nuevo reglamento. Su objetivo sigue siendo producir carga en Corner Mode, pero también garantizar que la resistencia se reduzca a velocidades más altas, en las rectas, cuando está en Straight Mode.

australia-2026-doc-9-alpine-engine-cover.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Coke/Engine Cover","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Complete new bodywork","The bodywork has been designed to accommodate the new ’ 26 power unit and ensure its cooling. It has also been designed with the objective of delivering high quality flow towards the rear end in all operating conditions.","Coke/Engine Cover | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Complete new bodywork | The bodywork has been designed to accommodate the new ’ 26 power unit and ensure its cooling. It has also been designed with the objective of delivering high quality flow towards the rear end in all operating conditions."]

es.componentName: Zona de estrechamiento trasero / Cubierta del motor
es.geometricDifference: Carrocería completamente nueva
es.briefDescription: La carrocería se ha diseñado para alojar la nueva unidad de potencia de 2026 y garantizar su refrigeración. También se ha diseñado con el objetivo de entregar flujo de alta calidad hacia la parte trasera en todas las condiciones de funcionamiento.

australia-2026-doc-9-alpine-rear-wing-3.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","Complete new rear wing design in accordance with the 2026 regulations","With no beam wing in 2026, and new regulations allowing the rear wing to be in Straight Mode in most of the straight lines, the rear wing was completely redesigned to ensure load is generated without any local flow field instabilities.","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | Complete new rear wing design in accordance with the 2026 regulations | With no beam wing in 2026, and new regulations allowing the rear wing to be in Straight Mode in most of the straight lines, the rear wing was completely redesigned to ensure load is generated without any local flow field instabilities."]

es.geometricDifference: Diseño completamente nuevo del alerón trasero conforme al reglamento de 2026
es.briefDescription: Al no haber ala inferior en 2026 y permitir el nuevo reglamento que el alerón trasero esté en Straight Mode en la mayoría de las rectas, se ha rediseñado por completo para garantizar la generación de carga sin inestabilidades locales del campo de flujo.

australia-2026-doc-9-audi-front-wing-1.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Separate SLM actuators for each side of the front wing flap.","Our approach is focused on matching the desired flow conditions aft of the front wing for the front suspension and bodywork immediately behind it. The separate SLM actuators for each side of the front wing flap are part of that intent.","Front Wing | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Separate SLM actuators for each side of the front wing flap. | Our approach is focused on matching the desired flow conditions aft of the front wing for the front suspension and bodywork immediately behind it. The separate SLM actuators for each side of the front wing flap are part of that intent."]

es.geometricDifference: Actuadores SLM separados para cada lado del flap del alerón delantero.
es.briefDescription: Nuestro enfoque se centra en obtener las condiciones de flujo deseadas detrás del alerón delantero para la suspensión delantera y la carrocería situada inmediatamente detrás. Los actuadores SLM separados para cada lado del flap del alerón delantero forman parte de ese objetivo.

australia-2026-doc-9-audi-sidepods-2.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Sidepod Inlet","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Unique geometry, shaped to work closely with the floor and rear bodywork.","Our solution to the cooling inlets and front of sidepod geometry is unique, it is a philosophy which links with how our floor and bodywork aft of the sidepod front work as an aerodynamic system from front to back.","Sidepod Inlet | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Unique geometry, shaped to work closely with the floor and rear bodywork. | Our solution to the cooling inlets and front of sidepod geometry is unique, it is a philosophy which links with how our floor and bodywork aft of the sidepod front work as an aerodynamic system from front to back."]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría singular, diseñada para trabajar estrechamente con el piso y la carrocería trasera.
es.briefDescription: Nuestra solución para las entradas de refrigeración y la geometría de la parte delantera del pontón es singular; es una filosofía relacionada con la forma en que nuestro piso y la carrocería situada detrás de la parte delantera del pontón trabajan como sistema aerodinámico desde delante hacia atrás.

australia-2026-doc-9-audi-sidepods-3.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Sidepod Body","Performance - Flow Conditioning","“Down-wash” geometry, with the upper surface of the sidepod sloping downwards towards the back of the car.","Most teams encourage a level of \"down-wash\" for the main body of the sidepods, which is generated by the upper surface sloping downwards towards the back of the car, whilst also generating \"in-wash\" through a narrowing of the bodywork towards the back of the car. Our sidepods are heavily down- wash biased - possibly the most extreme on the grid, whilst other have found a different compromise or reverted to a heavy in-wash bias.","Sidepod Body | Performance - Flow Conditioning | “Down-wash” geometry, with the upper surface of the sidepod sloping downwards towards the back of the car. | Most teams encourage a level of \"down-wash\" for the main body of the sidepods, which is generated by the upper surface sloping downwards towards the back of the car, whilst also generating \"in-wash\" through a narrowing of the bodywork towards the back of the car. Our sidepods are heavily down- wash biased - possibly the most extreme on the grid, whilst other have found a different compromise or reverted to a heavy in-wash bias."]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría que dirige el flujo hacia abajo, con la superficie superior del pontón descendiendo hacia la parte trasera del coche.
es.briefDescription: La mayoría de los equipos favorece cierto nivel de flujo descendente en el cuerpo principal de los pontones, generado por la pendiente hacia abajo de la superficie superior hacia la parte trasera del coche, y también genera flujo hacia el interior mediante el estrechamiento de la carrocería hacia atrás. Nuestros pontones están muy orientados al flujo descendente —posiblemente los más extremos de la parrilla—, mientras que otros han encontrado un compromiso distinto o han vuelto a una fuerte orientación al flujo hacia el interior.

australia-2026-doc-9-cadillac-front-wing.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing","Performance - Local Load","Updated flap design with revised spanwise loading.","Revised the front flap design with an updated spanwise load distribution to enhance overall front wing performance and improve balance characteristics.","Front Wing | Performance - Local Load | Updated flap design with revised spanwise loading. | Revised the front flap design with an updated spanwise load distribution to enhance overall front wing performance and improve balance characteristics."]

es.geometricDifference: Diseño actualizado del flap con distribución de carga revisada a lo largo de la envergadura.
es.briefDescription: Se ha revisado el diseño del flap delantero con una distribución de carga actualizada a lo largo de la envergadura para mejorar el rendimiento global del alerón delantero y las características de equilibrio.

australia-2026-doc-9-cadillac-front-wing.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Front Wing Endplate","Performance – Local Load","Updated end plate design with revised inboard detail.","Updated design to enhance the aerodynamic load characteristics of the front wing, reduce sensitivity to varying operating conditions, and deliver more consistent and predictable performance across a range of speeds and flow environments.","Front Wing Endplate | Performance – Local Load | Updated end plate design with revised inboard detail. | Updated design to enhance the aerodynamic load characteristics of the front wing, reduce sensitivity to varying operating conditions, and deliver more consistent and predictable performance across a range of speeds and flow environments."]

es.geometricDifference: Diseño actualizado de la placa lateral con detalles interiores revisados.
es.briefDescription: Diseño actualizado para mejorar las características de carga aerodinámica del alerón delantero, reducir la sensibilidad a distintas condiciones de funcionamiento y ofrecer un rendimiento más consistente y predecible en un rango de velocidades y entornos de flujo.

australia-2026-doc-9-cadillac-rear-wing-.sourceKey: ["9e9ccc09667faa4f612a32edab64e41b1d7ff914778e5681d96cd4ff81dbb5dd","Rear Wing","Performance – Local Load","Updated design with revised flap loading.","Improved yaw characteristics whilst being designed to maximise aerodynamic load when cornering and maximise the drag reduction when SLM is active.","Rear Wing | Performance – Local Load | Updated design with revised flap loading. | Improved yaw characteristics whilst being designed to maximise aerodynamic load when cornering and maximise the drag reduction when SLM is active."]

es.geometricDifference: Diseño actualizado con distribución de carga revisada del flap.
es.briefDescription: Características en guiñada mejoradas, con un diseño orientado a maximizar la carga aerodinámica en curva y la reducción de resistencia cuando SLM está activo.

austria-2026-doc-14-mclaren-rear-corner-.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Rear Corner","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Revised Rear Brake Duct Inlet","The rear brake duct inlet has been revised, targeting an improvement in local flow conditioning and resultant gain in aerodynamic load generated around the rear corner.","Rear Corner | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Revised Rear Brake Duct Inlet | The rear brake duct inlet has been revised, targeting an improvement in local flow conditioning and resultant gain in aerodynamic load generated around the rear corner."]

es.geometricDifference: Entrada revisada del conducto de freno trasero
es.briefDescription: Se ha revisado la entrada del conducto de freno trasero buscando mejorar el acondicionamiento local del flujo y obtener una ganancia de carga aerodinámica alrededor del conjunto trasero.

austria-2026-doc-14-mclaren-rear-wing-2.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Rear Wing","Performance - Drag reduction","Alternative Straight Line Mode Flap Position","The rear wing has been modified to deploy the flap to an alternative position in straight line mode resulting in a larger reduction in drag.","Rear Wing | Performance - Drag reduction | Alternative Straight Line Mode Flap Position | The rear wing has been modified to deploy the flap to an alternative position in straight line mode resulting in a larger reduction in drag."]

es.primaryReason: Rendimiento - Reducción de la resistencia aerodinámica
es.geometricDifference: Posición alternativa del flap en modo recta
es.briefDescription: El alerón trasero se ha modificado para desplegar el flap en una posición alternativa en modo de recta, obteniendo una mayor reducción de la resistencia.

austria-2026-doc-14-mercedes-front-suspe.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Front Suspension","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Leg fairing angle of attack adjustment","Leg fairing angle of attacked adjusted to improve alignment to onset flow throughout ride height range, resulting in improved flow to the rear of the car.","Front Suspension | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Leg fairing angle of attack adjustment | Leg fairing angle of attacked adjusted to improve alignment to onset flow throughout ride height range, resulting in improved flow to the rear of the car."]

es.geometricDifference: Ajuste del ángulo de ataque del carenado de la pata
es.briefDescription: Se ha ajustado el ángulo de ataque del carenado de la pata para mejorar la alineación con el flujo incidente en todo el rango de altura del coche, mejorando el flujo hacia la parte trasera.

austria-2026-doc-14-mercedes-engine-cove.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Coke/Engine Cover","Cooling Range","Narrower rear exit","A narrower rear exit allows more cooling range tuning, biasing more cooling flow to the louvres rather than the rear exit.","Coke/Engine Cover | Cooling Range | Narrower rear exit | A narrower rear exit allows more cooling range tuning, biasing more cooling flow to the louvres rather than the rear exit."]

es.componentName: Zona de estrechamiento trasero / Cubierta del motor
es.geometricDifference: Salida trasera más estrecha
es.briefDescription: Una salida trasera más estrecha permite ajustar más el rango de refrigeración, desviando más flujo de refrigeración hacia las branquias en vez de hacia la salida trasera.

austria-2026-doc-14-red-bull-racing-side.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Sidepod Inlet","Reliability","Revised sidepod inlet geometry extending downwards and rearwards","Optimised following earlier changes upstream the sidepod inlet has been re-profiled and re-positioned to capture air with good enough pressure for the radiators. This led to re-profiling to meet the floor.","Sidepod Inlet | Reliability | Revised sidepod inlet geometry extending downwards and rearwards | Optimised following earlier changes upstream the sidepod inlet has been re-profiled and re-positioned to capture air with good enough pressure for the radiators. This led to re-profiling to meet the floor."]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría revisada de la entrada del pontón, extendida hacia abajo y hacia atrás
es.briefDescription: Tras cambios anteriores aguas arriba, se ha optimizado el perfil y la posición de la entrada del pontón para captar aire con presión suficiente para los radiadores. Esto ha llevado a modificar los perfiles para ajustarse al piso.

austria-2026-doc-14-red-bull-racing-engi.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Engine Cover","Reliability","Revised sidepod panels to meet the new inlet geometry then following the floor junction profile","Having altered the inlet, the consequence was then to re-optimise the sidepod profiles simultaneously matching the updated floor at the junction line. Minor changes to the central engine cover and cooling louvres.","Engine Cover | Reliability | Revised sidepod panels to meet the new inlet geometry then following the floor junction profile | Having altered the inlet, the consequence was then to re-optimise the sidepod profiles simultaneously matching the updated floor at the junction line. Minor changes to the central engine cover and cooling louvres."]

es.geometricDifference: Paneles del pontón revisados para adaptarse a la nueva geometría de entrada y seguir después el perfil de unión con el piso
es.briefDescription: Tras modificar la entrada, fue necesario volver a optimizar los perfiles del pontón, adaptándolos simultáneamente al piso actualizado en la línea de unión. Cambios menores en la cubierta central del motor y las branquias de refrigeración.

austria-2026-doc-14-red-bull-racing-floo.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Floor","Performance - Local Load","Subtle revisions to the surfaces including forward floor as well as the junction line with the topbody","A further iteration of optimisation to compliment the new sidepod inlet, extending to the forward floor and then to the sidepod all to generate more local load and extract performance","Floor | Performance - Local Load | Subtle revisions to the surfaces including forward floor as well as the junction line with the topbody | A further iteration of optimisation to compliment the new sidepod inlet, extending to the forward floor and then to the sidepod all to generate more local load and extract performance"]

es.geometricDifference: Revisiones sutiles de las superficies, incluida la parte delantera del piso y la línea de unión con la carrocería superior
es.briefDescription: Otra iteración de optimización que complementa la nueva entrada del pontón, extendiéndose a la parte delantera del piso y después al pontón, para generar más carga local y extraer rendimiento

austria-2026-doc-14-red-bull-racing-rear.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Rear Suspension","Performance - Local Load","Reprofiled fairings and junctions to the tail/gearbox and into the rear wheel bodywork","Revisions to the fairings to better match the upstream conditions and maintain flow stability whilst extracting more local load.","Rear Suspension | Performance - Local Load | Reprofiled fairings and junctions to the tail/gearbox and into the rear wheel bodywork | Revisions to the fairings to better match the upstream conditions and maintain flow stability whilst extracting more local load."]

es.geometricDifference: Carenados y uniones con la cola/caja de cambios y la carrocería de las ruedas traseras con perfiles modificados
es.briefDescription: Revisiones de los carenados para adaptarse mejor a las condiciones aguas arriba y mantener la estabilidad del flujo mientras se extrae más carga local.

austria-2026-doc-14-red-bull-racing-rear.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Rear Corner","Performance - Local Load","Revised for the rear suspension fairings and attendant winglets","Primarily inboard of the rear wheels to accommodate the fairing revisions and blends into the wheel bodywork keeping the surfaces tidy whilst maintaining flow stability.","Rear Corner | Performance - Local Load | Revised for the rear suspension fairings and attendant winglets | Primarily inboard of the rear wheels to accommodate the fairing revisions and blends into the wheel bodywork keeping the surfaces tidy whilst maintaining flow stability."]

es.geometricDifference: Revisión de los carenados de la suspensión trasera y los aletines asociados
es.briefDescription: Principalmente en el interior de las ruedas traseras, para alojar las revisiones de los carenados y sus transiciones hacia la carrocería de las ruedas, manteniendo las superficies bien integradas y la estabilidad del flujo.

austria-2026-doc-14-red-bull-racing-rear.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","Revised pylon profiles","Given the pylons now by regulation contact the mainplane underside, the interface is sensitive and revised with pylon changes to the same element profiles seeking to extract more load and at least maintain flow stability.","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | Revised pylon profiles | Given the pylons now by regulation contact the mainplane underside, the interface is sensitive and revised with pylon changes to the same element profiles seeking to extract more load and at least maintain flow stability."]

es.geometricDifference: Perfiles revisados de los pilares
es.briefDescription: Dado que el reglamento hace ahora que los pilares contacten con la cara inferior del plano principal, la interfaz es sensible y se revisa mediante cambios en los perfiles de los pilares y del propio elemento, buscando extraer más carga y, como mínimo, mantener la estabilidad del flujo.

austria-2026-doc-14-red-bull-racing-exha.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Exhaust Tailpipe","Performance - Local Load","Revised overlap between the tailpipe exit profile and the supporting tailpipe bracket","A subtle re-positioning of the tailpipe has enabled the last portion, which is regulated to circulated and within a limited angle range to have greater overlap with the one permitted supporting bracket to extract more local load.","Exhaust Tailpipe | Performance - Local Load | Revised overlap between the tailpipe exit profile and the supporting tailpipe bracket | A subtle re-positioning of the tailpipe has enabled the last portion, which is regulated to circulated and within a limited angle range to have greater overlap with the one permitted supporting bracket to extract more local load."]

es.geometricDifference: Solapamiento revisado entre el perfil de salida del tubo de escape y el soporte que lo sostiene
es.briefDescription: Un ligero cambio de posición del tubo de escape ha permitido que la última parte, cuyo recorrido circular y rango de ángulos están regulados, tenga mayor solapamiento con el único soporte permitido, para extraer más carga local.

austria-2026-doc-14-ferrari-front-wing-1.sourceKey: ["7863deb797bed267fdd978e66170d86f755cf576cffce202739fadf712de0a6c","Front Wing Endplate","Performance - Local Load","Revised front wing endplate with new diveplane and new footplate vane arrangement","Further step applied to the new geometry introduced in the previous race in Spain, consolidating the original flow features and performance objectives of this front wing","Front Wing Endplate | Performance - Local Load | Revised front wing endplate with new diveplane and new footplate vane arrangement | Further step applied to the new geometry introduced in the previous race in Spain, consolidating the original flow features and performance objectives of this front wing"]

bahrain-2026-doc-12-mclaren-engine-cover.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Coke/Engine Cover","Circuit specific - Cooling Range","High Cooling Bodywork","To meet the high cooling demands of this and the upcoming circuits, a new engine cover aiming at increased cooling massflow has been designed.","Coke/Engine Cover | Circuit specific - Cooling Range | High Cooling Bodywork | To meet the high cooling demands of this and the upcoming circuits, a new engine cover aiming at increased cooling massflow has been designed."]

es.componentName: Zona de estrechamiento trasero / Cubierta del motor
es.primaryReason: Específico del circuito - Rango de refrigeración
es.geometricDifference: Carrocería de alta refrigeración
es.briefDescription: Para responder a las elevadas demandas de refrigeración de este circuito y de los próximos, se ha diseñado una nueva cubierta del motor destinada a aumentar el caudal másico de refrigeración.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-mercedes-floor-1.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Floor Board","Performance – Local Load","Reprofiled horizontal elements, and vertical slotted upper element added.","Reprofiled elements and new vertical elements added to improve local pressure distribution, reduce separations at the extremes of the operating envelope, and improve flow to the rear of the car, resulting in increased load.","Floor Board | Performance – Local Load | Reprofiled horizontal elements, and vertical slotted upper element added. | Reprofiled elements and new vertical elements added to improve local pressure distribution, reduce separations at the extremes of the operating envelope, and improve flow to the rear of the car, resulting in increased load."]

es.geometricDifference: Elementos horizontales con perfiles modificados y adición de un elemento superior vertical ranurado.
es.briefDescription: Elementos con perfiles modificados y nuevos elementos verticales añadidos para mejorar la distribución local de presión, reducir las separaciones en los extremos del rango de funcionamiento y mejorar el flujo hacia la parte trasera del coche, aumentando la carga.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-mercedes-floor-2.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Floor Leading Edge","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Reprofiled and additional down-washing elements added.","Additional down-washing elements increase local load and outwash, improving flow to the rear of the car and increasing rear floor load.","Floor Leading Edge | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Reprofiled and additional down-washing elements added. | Additional down-washing elements increase local load and outwash, improving flow to the rear of the car and increasing rear floor load."]

es.geometricDifference: Adición de elementos con perfiles modificados que dirigen el flujo hacia abajo.
es.briefDescription: Los elementos adicionales que dirigen el flujo hacia abajo aumentan la carga local y el flujo hacia el exterior, mejorando el flujo hacia la parte trasera del coche y aumentando la carga de la parte trasera del piso.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-mercedes-floor-3.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Floor Corner","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Additional slots and reprofiled elements.","Re-optimisation of floor corner slot arrangement to both increase local load and to also improve flow into the diffuser and hence rear load.","Floor Corner | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Additional slots and reprofiled elements. | Re-optimisation of floor corner slot arrangement to both increase local load and to also improve flow into the diffuser and hence rear load."]

es.geometricDifference: Ranuras adicionales y elementos con perfiles modificados.
es.briefDescription: Reoptimización de la disposición de ranuras de la zona lateral del piso para aumentar la carga local y mejorar también el flujo hacia el difusor y, por tanto, la carga trasera.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-mercedes-floor-4.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Floor Body","Performance – Local Load","Reprofiled diffuser roof, sidewall, and winglet.","Through re-optimisation of the diffuser roof and sidewall we have increased local load and improved robustness throughout the operating envelope.","Floor Body | Performance – Local Load | Reprofiled diffuser roof, sidewall, and winglet. | Through re-optimisation of the diffuser roof and sidewall we have increased local load and improved robustness throughout the operating envelope."]

es.geometricDifference: Techo, pared lateral y aletín del difusor con perfiles modificados.
es.briefDescription: Mediante la reoptimización del techo y la pared lateral del difusor hemos aumentado la carga local y mejorado la robustez en todo el rango de funcionamiento.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-mercedes-rear-suspen.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Rear Suspension","Performance – Local Load","Reprofiled suspension fairings.","Track rod and driveshaft camber re-distributed to increase local load whilst improving coupling with diffuser winglet and rear drum furniture.","Rear Suspension | Performance – Local Load | Reprofiled suspension fairings. | Track rod and driveshaft camber re-distributed to increase local load whilst improving coupling with diffuser winglet and rear drum furniture."]

es.geometricDifference: Carenados de la suspensión con perfiles modificados.
es.briefDescription: Redistribución de la curvatura de la barra de dirección y el semieje para aumentar la carga local y mejorar el acoplamiento con el aletín del difusor y los elementos auxiliares del tambor trasero.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-mercedes-rear-corner.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Rear Corner","Performance – Local Load","Rear winglet span and position change.","Chord and position of the rear drum winglets re- optimised to work with above fairing update and to improve rear tyre wake control across the operating envelope.","Rear Corner | Performance – Local Load | Rear winglet span and position change. | Chord and position of the rear drum winglets re- optimised to work with above fairing update and to improve rear tyre wake control across the operating envelope."]

es.geometricDifference: Cambio de envergadura y posición del aletín trasero.
es.briefDescription: Cuerda y posición de los aletines del tambor trasero reoptimizadas para trabajar con la actualización del carenado anterior y mejorar el control de la estela del neumático trasero en todo el rango de funcionamiento.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-mercedes-rear-bodywo.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Rear Bodywork","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Reduce volume, increased sideview ramp.","Reduce volume and increased sideview ramp increases downwash to the rear floor and rear drum, resulting in more load.","Rear Bodywork | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Reduce volume, increased sideview ramp. | Reduce volume and increased sideview ramp increases downwash to the rear floor and rear drum, resulting in more load."]

es.geometricDifference: Volumen reducido y rampa más pronunciada en la vista lateral.
es.briefDescription: La reducción de volumen y la rampa más pronunciada en la vista lateral aumentan el flujo descendente hacia la parte trasera del piso y el tambor trasero, generando más carga.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-red-bull-racing-floo.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Floor Board","Performance - Local Load","Revised Floor Board geometry","Applied above the existing floor foot geometry, the new board realises development work to extract more load locally whilst maintaining flow stability behind the front tyres.","Floor Board | Performance - Local Load | Revised Floor Board geometry | Applied above the existing floor foot geometry, the new board realises development work to extract more load locally whilst maintaining flow stability behind the front tyres."]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría revisada del panel del piso
es.briefDescription: Aplicado sobre la geometría existente del pie del piso, el nuevo panel materializa el desarrollo realizado para extraer más carga local y mantener la estabilidad del flujo detrás de los neumáticos delanteros.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-ferrari-diffuser-1.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Diffuser","Performance - Local Load","Diffuser outboard winglet cascade element development","Not Sepang track specific, this very localized development around the diffuser winglet cascade is providing a favourable additional downforce across the entire car operating envelope","Diffuser | Performance - Local Load | Diffuser outboard winglet cascade element development | Not Sepang track specific, this very localized development around the diffuser winglet cascade is providing a favourable additional downforce across the entire car operating envelope"]

es.geometricDifference: Desarrollo de los elementos de la cascada de aletines exteriores del difusor
es.briefDescription: Sin ser específico del circuito de Sepang, este desarrollo muy localizado alrededor de la cascada de aletines del difusor proporciona carga aerodinámica adicional favorable en todo el rango de funcionamiento del coche

bahrain-2026-doc-12-racing-bulls-front-w.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Front Wing","Circuit specific - Balance Range","New front flap","A longer chord flap for the front wing that was introduced at the previous event increases the load that can be generated by the wing, meeting the aero balance requirements for this circuit.","Front Wing | Circuit specific - Balance Range | New front flap | A longer chord flap for the front wing that was introduced at the previous event increases the load that can be generated by the wing, meeting the aero balance requirements for this circuit."]

es.primaryReason: Específico del circuito - Rango de equilibrio
es.geometricDifference: Nuevo flap delantero
es.briefDescription: Un flap de mayor cuerda para el alerón delantero introducido en el evento anterior aumenta la carga que puede generar el alerón, cumpliendo los requisitos de equilibrio aerodinámico de este circuito.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-racing-bulls-rear-wi.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","Revised rear wing auxiliary components","An improved design of the rear wing support components allows the rear wing to perform more effectively, increasing the efficiency of load generated.","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | Revised rear wing auxiliary components | An improved design of the rear wing support components allows the rear wing to perform more effectively, increasing the efficiency of load generated."]

es.geometricDifference: Componentes auxiliares revisados del alerón trasero
es.briefDescription: Un diseño mejorado de los componentes de soporte del alerón trasero permite que éste trabaje con mayor eficacia, aumentando la eficiencia de la carga generada.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-haas-rear-impact-str.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Rear Impact Structure","Performance – Local Load","Updated Rear Impact Structure geometry","An additional Rear Impact Structure device will be available on track, enabling targeted tuning of the car’s characteristics for this circuit.","Rear Impact Structure | Performance – Local Load | Updated Rear Impact Structure geometry | An additional Rear Impact Structure device will be available on track, enabling targeted tuning of the car’s characteristics for this circuit."]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría actualizada de la estructura de impacto trasera
es.briefDescription: Habrá un dispositivo adicional de la estructura de impacto trasera disponible en pista, permitiendo ajustar de forma específica las características del coche para este circuito.

bahrain-2026-doc-12-alpine-front-corner-.sourceKey: ["be68005deb6890e760be6fc032dc7026c7a44f8761ad5894a617d855e9218e3c","Front Corner","Performance – Brake Cooling","Revised front drum exit","The front drum exit has been trimmed to increase brake cooling capacity, improving thermal management for the upcoming high-demand tracks.","Front Corner | Performance – Brake Cooling | Revised front drum exit | The front drum exit has been trimmed to increase brake cooling capacity, improving thermal management for the upcoming high-demand tracks."]

es.geometricDifference: Salida revisada del tambor delantero
es.briefDescription: Se ha recortado la salida del tambor delantero para aumentar la capacidad de refrigeración de los frenos y mejorar la gestión térmica para los próximos circuitos de alta exigencia.

barcelona-catalunya-2026-doc-14-mclaren-.sourceKey: ["26ba7ae0bf3556c02d0ba691fa350f7d56ec08e9d1830ff10b416429a833c7e9","Front Wing","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Revised Front Wing Endplate","The front wing endplate has been modified, resulting in an improvement of aerodynamic flow conditioning and subsequently enhanced aerodynamic overall performance.","Front Wing | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Revised Front Wing Endplate | The front wing endplate has been modified, resulting in an improvement of aerodynamic flow conditioning and subsequently enhanced aerodynamic overall performance."]

es.geometricDifference: Placa lateral revisada del alerón delantero
es.briefDescription: Se ha modificado la placa lateral del alerón delantero, mejorando el acondicionamiento del flujo aerodinámico y, en consecuencia, el rendimiento aerodinámico global.

barcelona-catalunya-2026-doc-14-mercedes.sourceKey: ["26ba7ae0bf3556c02d0ba691fa350f7d56ec08e9d1830ff10b416429a833c7e9","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","Small winglets added on centreline to rear wing.","These winglets increase the camber of the upper rear wing on centreline, generating downforce and drag at a ratio attractive for this event.","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | Small winglets added on centreline to rear wing. | These winglets increase the camber of the upper rear wing on centreline, generating downforce and drag at a ratio attractive for this event."]

es.geometricDifference: Pequeños aletines añadidos en la línea central del alerón trasero.
es.briefDescription: Estos aletines aumentan la curvatura de la zona central del alerón trasero superior, generando carga aerodinámica y resistencia en una proporción atractiva para este evento.

barcelona-catalunya-2026-doc-14-red-bull.sourceKey: ["26ba7ae0bf3556c02d0ba691fa350f7d56ec08e9d1830ff10b416429a833c7e9","Front Wing","Local load and flow conditioning.","The wing element geometries have been revised where these meet the endplate","Achieved by modifying existing parts, a new geometry of the elements near the end plate becomes available. es.primaryReason: Carga local y acondicionamiento del flujo.
es.geometricDifference: Se han revisado las geometrías de los elementos del alerón donde se unen a la placa lateral
es.briefDescription: Mediante la modificación de piezas existentes se dispone de una nueva geometría de los elementos próximos a la placa lateral. El objetivo es mejorar la carga local manteniendo la estabilidad del flujo.

barcelona-catalunya-2026-doc-14-red-bull.sourceKey: ["26ba7ae0bf3556c02d0ba691fa350f7d56ec08e9d1830ff10b416429a833c7e9","Front wing","Balance range","Camber increase of the front wing flaps.","Should the front wing load demand exceed expectations, a more cambered flap assembly has been produced to offer more local load.","Front wing | Balance range | Camber increase of the front wing flaps. | Should the front wing load demand exceed expectations, a more cambered flap assembly has been produced to offer more local load."]

es.geometricDifference: Aumento de la curvatura de los flaps del alerón delantero.
es.briefDescription: Por si la demanda de carga del alerón delantero supera las expectativas, se ha producido un conjunto de flaps de mayor curvatura para ofrecer más carga local.
