british-2026-doc-13-ferrari-rear-corner-.sourceKey: ["949f1403db5591bb62d84c2f0a3072368d725207a8f281dcf5b9a458a7d04204","Rear Corner","Performance - Local Load and Cooling","Increased cooling inlet and outlet sections, updated lower deflector, re-optimized rearward winglet cluster","This update has 2 main objectives: corner cooling via increased inlet/outlet sections, and local loading via lower deflector redesign and winglet loading optimisation, maximizing aerodynamic efficiency","Rear Corner | Performance - Local Load and Cooling | Increased cooling inlet and outlet sections, updated lower deflector, re-optimized rearward winglet cluster | This update has 2 main objectives: corner cooling via increased inlet/outlet sections, and local loading via lower deflector redesign and winglet loading optimisation, maximizing aerodynamic efficiency"]

es.geometricDifference: Secciones de entrada y salida de refrigeración ampliadas, deflector inferior actualizado y conjunto de aletines posteriores reoptimizado
es.briefDescription: Esta actualización tiene 2 objetivos principales: refrigeración del conjunto mediante secciones de entrada/salida ampliadas y carga local mediante el rediseño del deflector inferior y la optimización de carga de los aletines, maximizando la eficiencia aerodinámica

british-2026-doc-13-williams-front-wing-.sourceKey: ["949f1403db5591bb62d84c2f0a3072368d725207a8f281dcf5b9a458a7d04204","Front Wing","Performance – Flow Conditioning","A new front wing geometry with updated profiles and endplate surfaces.","An updated front wing assembly has been developed, which aims to generate an increase in local loading combined with an improved flow field interaction with downstream components.","Front Wing | Performance – Flow Conditioning | A new front wing geometry with updated profiles and endplate surfaces. | An updated front wing assembly has been developed, which aims to generate an increase in local loading combined with an improved flow field interaction with downstream components."]

es.geometricDifference: Nueva geometría del alerón delantero con perfiles y superficies de la placa lateral actualizados.
es.briefDescription: Se ha desarrollado un conjunto actualizado de alerón delantero para aumentar la carga local y mejorar la interacción del campo de flujo con los componentes posteriores.

british-2026-doc-13-racing-bulls-floor-1.sourceKey: ["949f1403db5591bb62d84c2f0a3072368d725207a8f281dcf5b9a458a7d04204","Floor Edge & Diffuser","Performance – Local Load","Updated floor corner & diffuser geometry","The combined updates optimise the flow around the rear floor, allowing it to generate more load and provide increased performance.","Floor Edge & Diffuser | Performance – Local Load | Updated floor corner & diffuser geometry | The combined updates optimise the flow around the rear floor, allowing it to generate more load and provide increased performance."]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría actualizada de la zona lateral del piso y del difusor
es.briefDescription: Las actualizaciones combinadas optimizan el flujo alrededor de la parte trasera del piso, permitiendo que genere más carga y proporcione mayor rendimiento.

british-2026-doc-13-racing-bulls-rear-co.sourceKey: ["949f1403db5591bb62d84c2f0a3072368d725207a8f281dcf5b9a458a7d04204","Rear Corner","Performance – Flow Conditioning","New forward deflector geometry","In combination with the above, the new deflector targets an improvement in local flow conditioning and improved floor performance.","Rear Corner | Performance – Flow Conditioning | New forward deflector geometry | In combination with the above, the new deflector targets an improvement in local flow conditioning and improved floor performance."]

es.geometricDifference: Nueva geometría del deflector delantero
es.briefDescription: Junto con lo anterior, el nuevo deflector busca mejorar el acondicionamiento local del flujo y el rendimiento del piso.

british-2026-doc-13-haas-rear-wing-1.sourceKey: ["949f1403db5591bb62d84c2f0a3072368d725207a8f281dcf5b9a458a7d04204","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","New Rear Wing profiles","The rear wing profiles were comprehensively revised, with particular emphasis placed on the optimisation of flap geometry, leading to an increase in aerodynamic load while preserving a high level of overall efficiency across the operating range.","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | New Rear Wing profiles | The rear wing profiles were comprehensively revised, with particular emphasis placed on the optimisation of flap geometry, leading to an increase in aerodynamic load while preserving a high level of overall efficiency across the operating range."]

es.geometricDifference: Nuevos perfiles del alerón trasero
es.briefDescription: Los perfiles del alerón trasero se han revisado de forma integral, prestando especial atención a la optimización de la geometría del flap, lo que aumenta la carga aerodinámica y conserva un alto nivel de eficiencia global en todo el rango de funcionamiento.

british-2026-doc-13-haas-rear-wing-2.sourceKey: ["949f1403db5591bb62d84c2f0a3072368d725207a8f281dcf5b9a458a7d04204","Rear Wing Endplate","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Rear Wing Endplate with external protrusions","The Rear Wing Endplates were refined through the introduction of localized protrusions aimed at promoting upwash, contributing to the increase of load of this assembly.","Rear Wing Endplate | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Rear Wing Endplate with external protrusions | The Rear Wing Endplates were refined through the introduction of localized protrusions aimed at promoting upwash, contributing to the increase of load of this assembly."]

es.geometricDifference: Placa lateral del alerón trasero con salientes exteriores
es.briefDescription: Las placas laterales del alerón trasero se han refinado introduciendo salientes localizados destinados a favorecer el flujo ascendente, contribuyendo al aumento de carga de este conjunto.

canada-2026-doc-11-mclaren-front-wing-1.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Wing","Performance - Flow Conditioning","New Front Wing","A new front wing design, aimed at better flow conditioning across the operating range resulting in improved aerodynamic load delivery.","Front Wing | Performance - Flow Conditioning | New Front Wing | A new front wing design, aimed at better flow conditioning across the operating range resulting in improved aerodynamic load delivery."]

es.geometricDifference: Nuevo alerón delantero
es.briefDescription: Nuevo diseño del alerón delantero orientado a mejorar el acondicionamiento del flujo en todo el rango de funcionamiento, mejorando la generación de carga aerodinámica.

canada-2026-doc-11-mclaren-engine-cover-.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Coke/Engine Cover","Performance - Flow Conditioning","New Bodywork","A revised bodywork package featuring additional cooling exits aiming at improved aerodynamic flow conditioning towards the rear of the car.","Coke/Engine Cover | Performance - Flow Conditioning | New Bodywork | A revised bodywork package featuring additional cooling exits aiming at improved aerodynamic flow conditioning towards the rear of the car."]

es.componentName: Zona de estrechamiento trasero / Cubierta del motor
es.geometricDifference: Nueva carrocería
es.briefDescription: Conjunto de carrocería revisado con salidas de refrigeración adicionales, destinado a mejorar el acondicionamiento del flujo aerodinámico hacia la parte trasera del coche.

canada-2026-doc-11-mclaren-cooling-3.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Cooling Louvres","Circuit specific - Cooling Range","Cooling Louvre Options","As part of the new bodywork package, multiple cooling louvre options are available to cover the full range of ambient temperatures expected at this and future events.","Cooling Louvres | Circuit specific - Cooling Range | Cooling Louvre Options | As part of the new bodywork package, multiple cooling louvre options are available to cover the full range of ambient temperatures expected at this and future events."]

es.primaryReason: Específico del circuito - Rango de refrigeración
es.geometricDifference: Opciones de branquias de refrigeración
es.briefDescription: Como parte del nuevo conjunto de carrocería, hay varias opciones de branquias de refrigeración para cubrir todo el rango de temperaturas ambiente previsto en este evento y los próximos.

canada-2026-doc-11-mclaren-halo-4.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Halo","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Halo Winglet","A new winglet on top of the halo, aiming at improved management of aerodynamic flow around the cockpit and central engine cover.","Halo | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Halo Winglet | A new winglet on top of the halo, aiming at improved management of aerodynamic flow around the cockpit and central engine cover."]

es.geometricDifference: Aletín del halo
es.briefDescription: Nuevo aletín sobre el halo, destinado a mejorar la gestión del flujo aerodinámico alrededor del cockpit y de la cubierta central del motor.

canada-2026-doc-11-mclaren-rear-wing-5.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Rear Wing Endplate","Performance - Local Load","Revised Rear Wing Endplate","Modification to the rear wing endplate geometry resulting in a change in load distribution and increase in local aerodynamic load.","Rear Wing Endplate | Performance - Local Load | Revised Rear Wing Endplate | Modification to the rear wing endplate geometry resulting in a change in load distribution and increase in local aerodynamic load."]

es.geometricDifference: Placa lateral revisada del alerón trasero
es.briefDescription: Modificación de la geometría de la placa lateral del alerón trasero que cambia la distribución de carga y aumenta la carga aerodinámica local.

canada-2026-doc-11-mclaren-rear-suspensi.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Rear Suspension","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Revised Rear Suspension Fairings","Small modification to the rear suspension fairings aimed at improved aerodynamic flow conditioning and load generation around the rear corner and diffuser.","Rear Suspension | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Revised Rear Suspension Fairings | Small modification to the rear suspension fairings aimed at improved aerodynamic flow conditioning and load generation around the rear corner and diffuser."]

es.geometricDifference: Carenados revisados de la suspensión trasera
es.briefDescription: Pequeña modificación de los carenados de la suspensión trasera destinada a mejorar el acondicionamiento del flujo aerodinámico y la generación de carga alrededor del conjunto trasero y del difusor.

canada-2026-doc-11-mclaren-floor-7.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Floor Edge","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Revised Floor Edge Devices","Iteration on floor edge devices aimed at improved overall floor conditioning and aerodynamic load generation on the floor and diffuser.","Floor Edge | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Revised Floor Edge Devices | Iteration on floor edge devices aimed at improved overall floor conditioning and aerodynamic load generation on the floor and diffuser."]

es.geometricDifference: Dispositivos revisados del borde del piso
es.briefDescription: Iteración de los dispositivos del borde del piso destinada a mejorar el acondicionamiento global del flujo del piso y la generación de carga aerodinámica en el piso y el difusor.

canada-2026-doc-11-mercedes-front-wing-1.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Wing","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Front wing outboard elements dropped in height and run into the footplate.","Running the front wing elements into the footplate, and adding strakes, results in more robust flow structures, improving flow to the rear of the car and gaining downforce.","Front Wing | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Front wing outboard elements dropped in height and run into the footplate. | Running the front wing elements into the footplate, and adding strakes, results in more robust flow structures, improving flow to the rear of the car and gaining downforce."]

es.geometricDifference: Los elementos exteriores del alerón delantero se han bajado y desembocan en el pie.
es.briefDescription: Hacer que los elementos del alerón delantero desembocan en el pie y añadir aletas longitudinales produce estructuras de flujo más robustas, mejorando el flujo hacia la parte trasera del coche y aumentando la carga aerodinámica.

canada-2026-doc-11-mercedes-front-wing-2.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Wing Endplate","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Front wing endplate and footplate adjusted to accommodate the above. Footplate stakes added. Diveplane camber adjusted.","Running the front wing elements into the footplate, and adding strakes, results in more robust flow structures, improving flow to the rear of the car and gaining downforce.","Front Wing Endplate | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Front wing endplate and footplate adjusted to accommodate the above. Footplate stakes added. Diveplane camber adjusted. | Running the front wing elements into the footplate, and adding strakes, results in more robust flow structures, improving flow to the rear of the car and gaining downforce."]

es.geometricDifference: Placa lateral y pie del alerón delantero ajustados para alojar lo anterior. Se han añadido aletas al pie y ajustado la curvatura del aletín.
es.briefDescription: Hacer que los elementos del alerón delantero desembocan en el pie y añadir aletas longitudinales produce estructuras de flujo más robustas, mejorando el flujo hacia la parte trasera del coche y aumentando la carga aerodinámica.

canada-2026-doc-11-mercedes-front-corner.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Corner","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Front caketin upper lip camber reduced.","Reduced upper lip camber improves flow structure robustness throughout the operating envelope, improving the onset flow to the rear wing.","Front Corner | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Front caketin upper lip camber reduced. | Reduced upper lip camber improves flow structure robustness throughout the operating envelope, improving the onset flow to the rear wing."]

es.geometricDifference: Curvatura reducida del labio superior de la carcasa delantera del freno.
es.briefDescription: La menor curvatura del labio superior mejora la robustez de las estructuras del flujo en todo el rango de funcionamiento, mejorando el flujo incidente sobre el alerón trasero.

canada-2026-doc-11-mercedes-front-corner.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Corner","Circuit specific - Cooling Range","Increased inlet and exit size.","Due to the high braking demands of Montreal - increasing the duct inlet and exit size increases mass flow feeding the discs resulting in more cooling.","Front Corner | Circuit specific - Cooling Range | Increased inlet and exit size. | Due to the high braking demands of Montreal - increasing the duct inlet and exit size increases mass flow feeding the discs resulting in more cooling."]

es.primaryReason: Específico del circuito - Rango de refrigeración
es.geometricDifference: Mayor tamaño de entrada y salida.
es.briefDescription: Debido a las elevadas demandas de frenada de Montreal, aumentar el tamaño de entrada y salida del conducto incrementa el caudal másico que alimenta los discos y proporciona más refrigeración.

canada-2026-doc-11-mercedes-floor-5.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Floor Board","Performance – Local Load","Reprofiled elements","Reprofiled elements to improve local pressure distribution and reduce separations at the extremes of the operating envelope, resulting in increased local load.","Floor Board | Performance – Local Load | Reprofiled elements | Reprofiled elements to improve local pressure distribution and reduce separations at the extremes of the operating envelope, resulting in increased local load."]

es.geometricDifference: Elementos con perfiles modificados
es.briefDescription: Elementos con perfiles modificados para mejorar la distribución local de presión y reducir las separaciones en los extremos del rango de funcionamiento, aumentando la carga local.

canada-2026-doc-11-mercedes-floor-6.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Floor Corner","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Additional slots","Re-optimisation of floor corner slot arrangement to both increase local load and to also improve flow into the diffuser and hence rear load.","Floor Corner | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Additional slots | Re-optimisation of floor corner slot arrangement to both increase local load and to also improve flow into the diffuser and hence rear load."]

es.geometricDifference: Ranuras adicionales
es.briefDescription: Reoptimización de la disposición de ranuras de la zona lateral del piso para aumentar la carga local y mejorar también el flujo hacia el difusor y, por tanto, la carga trasera.

canada-2026-doc-11-mercedes-floor-7.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Floor Body","Performance – Local Load","Reprofiled diffuser roof","By reprofiling the diffuser roof and sidewall we improve the surface flow quality throughout the operating envelope and generate more local load.","Floor Body | Performance – Local Load | Reprofiled diffuser roof | By reprofiling the diffuser roof and sidewall we improve the surface flow quality throughout the operating envelope and generate more local load."]

es.geometricDifference: Techo del difusor con perfil modificado
es.briefDescription: Al modificar los perfiles del techo y la pared lateral del difusor, mejoramos la calidad del flujo superficial en todo el rango de funcionamiento y generamos más carga local.

canada-2026-doc-11-mercedes-rear-corner-.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Rear Corner","Performance – Local Load","Rear winglet span and position redistribution","Chord and position of the rear caketin winglets re-optimised to improve local flow control and performance of the diffuser.","Rear Corner | Performance – Local Load | Rear winglet span and position redistribution | Chord and position of the rear caketin winglets re-optimised to improve local flow control and performance of the diffuser."]

es.geometricDifference: Redistribución de envergadura y posición del aletín trasero
es.briefDescription: Cuerda y posición de los aletines de la carcasa del freno trasero reoptimizadas para mejorar el control local del flujo y el rendimiento del difusor.

canada-2026-doc-11-red-bull-racing-front.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Wing","Balance Range","Revised front wing flap elements","Both second and third front wing elements forming the flap assemblies are revised to shift the aerobalance range available for the upcoming circuits.","Front Wing | Balance Range | Revised front wing flap elements | Both second and third front wing elements forming the flap assemblies are revised to shift the aerobalance range available for the upcoming circuits."]

es.geometricDifference: Elementos revisados del flap del alerón delantero
es.briefDescription: Se han revisado tanto el segundo como el tercer elemento del alerón delantero, que forman los conjuntos de flap, para desplazar el rango de equilibrio aerodinámico disponible para los próximos circuitos.

canada-2026-doc-11-red-bull-racing-front.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Corner","Reliability","Revised brake duct exit geometry","The next two circuits on the calendar demand more brake assembly cooling and to offer this an enlarged exit duct has been produced to enhance the cooling","Front Corner | Reliability | Revised brake duct exit geometry | The next two circuits on the calendar demand more brake assembly cooling and to offer this an enlarged exit duct has been produced to enhance the cooling"]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría revisada de la salida del conducto de freno
es.briefDescription: Los próximos dos circuitos del calendario requieren más refrigeración del conjunto de frenos y, para proporcionarla, se ha producido un conducto de salida ampliado que aumenta la refrigeración

canada-2026-doc-11-red-bull-racing-floor.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Floor","Performance – Local load","Bib edge trim and revised forward floor devices","To further optimise both the bib and forward floor devices, the former has a trim applied and the latter mildly increased camber resulting in the local load increasing","Floor | Performance – Local load | Bib edge trim and revised forward floor devices | To further optimise both the bib and forward floor devices, the former has a trim applied and the latter mildly increased camber resulting in the local load increasing"]

es.geometricDifference: Recorte del borde del babero y dispositivos delanteros del piso revisados
es.briefDescription: Para optimizar aún más tanto el babero como los dispositivos delanteros del piso, se ha recortado el primero y aumentado ligeramente la curvatura de los segundos, incrementando la carga local

canada-2026-doc-11-red-bull-racing-engin.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Engine Cover","Reliability","Cooling exit panel option","Given the forecast for Montreal, a closed radiator exit panel has been created with the louvre steps necessary for the race in Miami now closed.","Engine Cover | Reliability | Cooling exit panel option | Given the forecast for Montreal, a closed radiator exit panel has been created with the louvre steps necessary for the race in Miami now closed."]

es.geometricDifference: Opción de panel de salida de refrigeración
es.briefDescription: Dada la previsión meteorológica para Montreal, se ha creado un panel cerrado de salida del radiador, cerrando los escalones de branquias necesarios para la carrera de Miami.

canada-2026-doc-11-williams-front-corner.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Corner","Circuit specific - Cooling Range","A new FBD scoop geometry with a reprofiled exit area.","To suit the demands of the Gilles-Villeneuve circuit, a new FBD geometry will be introduced which offers an increased level of overall brake system cooling.","Front Corner | Circuit specific - Cooling Range | A new FBD scoop geometry with a reprofiled exit area. | To suit the demands of the Gilles-Villeneuve circuit, a new FBD geometry will be introduced which offers an increased level of overall brake system cooling."]

es.primaryReason: Específico del circuito - Rango de refrigeración
es.geometricDifference: Nueva geometría de la toma del conducto de freno delantero con un área de salida de perfil modificado.
es.briefDescription: Para responder a las exigencias del circuito Gilles-Villeneuve, se introducirá una nueva geometría del conducto de freno delantero que ofrece un mayor nivel global de refrigeración del sistema de frenos.

canada-2026-doc-11-williams-front-suspen.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Front Suspension","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Revised suspension cladding surfaces, with changes in chord and incidence across their span.","In concert with the updated FBD geometry, new suspension cladding will be available to improve the local interactions on the front corner and hence downstream across the rest of the car.","Front Suspension | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Revised suspension cladding surfaces, with changes in chord and incidence across their span. | In concert with the updated FBD geometry, new suspension cladding will be available to improve the local interactions on the front corner and hence downstream across the rest of the car."]

es.geometricDifference: Superficies revisadas de los carenados de la suspensión, con cambios de cuerda e incidencia a lo largo de su envergadura.
es.briefDescription: Junto con la geometría actualizada del conducto de freno delantero, habrá nuevos carenados de suspensión para mejorar las interacciones locales en el conjunto delantero y, por tanto, aguas abajo en el resto del coche.

canada-2026-doc-11-williams-exhaust-tail.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Exhaust Tailpipe","Performance – Local Load","A repositioned exhaust tailpipe","Following on from an update introduced at the previous Miami GP, a further step on the exhaust system will be evaluated which offers an improved coupling with the surrounding aerodynamic components.","Exhaust Tailpipe | Performance – Local Load | A repositioned exhaust tailpipe | Following on from an update introduced at the previous Miami GP, a further step on the exhaust system will be evaluated which offers an improved coupling with the surrounding aerodynamic components."]

es.geometricDifference: Tubo de escape reposicionado
es.briefDescription: Tras una actualización introducida en el anterior GP de Miami, se evaluará un nuevo paso en el sistema de escape que ofrece un mejor acoplamiento con los componentes aerodinámicos circundantes.

canada-2026-doc-11-racing-bulls-floor-1.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Floor Body","Performance - Local Load","New Main Floor geometry","A new floor geometry resulting in an efficient downforce increase generated by the underbody of the car, across a range of operating conditions.","Floor Body | Performance - Local Load | New Main Floor geometry | A new floor geometry resulting in an efficient downforce increase generated by the underbody of the car, across a range of operating conditions."]

es.geometricDifference: Nueva geometría del piso principal
es.briefDescription: Nueva geometría del piso que aumenta de forma eficiente la carga aerodinámica generada por la zona inferior del coche en un rango de condiciones de funcionamiento.

canada-2026-doc-11-racing-bulls-rear-cor.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Rear Corner","Performance – Flow Conditioning","Reprofiled Rear Corner devices","Working in conjunction with the floor update, the changes to the rear corner devices improve the flow management at the back of the car.","Rear Corner | Performance – Flow Conditioning | Reprofiled Rear Corner devices | Working in conjunction with the floor update, the changes to the rear corner devices improve the flow management at the back of the car."]

es.geometricDifference: Dispositivos del conjunto trasero con perfiles modificados
es.briefDescription: Trabajando junto con la actualización del piso, los cambios en los dispositivos del conjunto trasero mejoran la gestión del flujo en la parte trasera del coche.

canada-2026-doc-11-racing-bulls-beam-win.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Beam Wing","Performance – Local Load","Profile and incidence modifications","Supporting the changes made to the floor and around the exhaust, the Beam Wing changes help extract additional load from the rear wing assembly.","Beam Wing | Performance – Local Load | Profile and incidence modifications | Supporting the changes made to the floor and around the exhaust, the Beam Wing changes help extract additional load from the rear wing assembly."]

es.geometricDifference: Modificaciones de perfil e incidencia
es.briefDescription: Como apoyo a los cambios realizados en el piso y alrededor del escape, los cambios en el ala inferior ayudan a extraer carga adicional del conjunto de alerón trasero.

canada-2026-doc-11-racing-bulls-exhaust-.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Exhaust Tailpipe Bracket","Performance – Flow Conditioning","Reprofiled tailpipe bracket","The tailpipe bracket update improves the flow management around the centreline of the car as part of the surrounding changes on the Beam Wing and floor.","Exhaust Tailpipe Bracket | Performance – Flow Conditioning | Reprofiled tailpipe bracket | The tailpipe bracket update improves the flow management around the centreline of the car as part of the surrounding changes on the Beam Wing and floor."]

es.geometricDifference: Soporte del tubo de escape con perfil modificado
es.briefDescription: La actualización del soporte del tubo de escape mejora la gestión del flujo alrededor de la línea central del coche como parte de los cambios circundantes en el ala inferior y el piso.

canada-2026-doc-11-haas-sidepods-1.sourceKey: ["5971fae2e70a5e17ad87fbdd400e2287f064ee830dfdada8be9f7f36c882193e","Sidepod Inlet","Performance - Flow Conditioning","Revised Sidepod Inlet","The revised bodywork enables a more pronounced undercut along the lower surfaces, which, combined with increased top ‑ surface downwash, channels higher ‑ energy airflow towards the rear of the car, allowing the bespoke floor design to operate more efficiently.","Sidepod Inlet | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Revised Sidepod Inlet | The revised bodywork enables a more pronounced undercut along the lower surfaces, which, combined with increased top ‑ surface downwash, channels higher ‑ energy airflow towards the rear of the car, allowing the bespoke floor design to operate more efficiently."]

es.briefDescription: Se instaló un dispositivo aerodinámico adicional detrás del tubo de escape, con el objetivo principal de favorecer el flujo ascendente local y mejorar así la generación de carga aerodinámica localizada en esa zona.

monaco-2026-doc-15-audi-front-wing-1.sourceKey: ["513eca62751dd9e24be31a313058e3efc949ad72ed25a21fbd5a86d1f2355996","Front Wing","Circuit specific - Local Load","SM actuators removed","This design change aims to reduce any unnecessary blockage on the front wing.","Front Wing | Circuit specific - Local Load | SM actuators removed | This design change aims to reduce any unnecessary blockage on the front wing."]

es.geometricDifference: Actuadores SM retirados
es.briefDescription: Este cambio de diseño busca reducir cualquier bloqueo innecesario en el alerón delantero.

monaco-2026-doc-15-audi-mirror-2.sourceKey: ["513eca62751dd9e24be31a313058e3efc949ad72ed25a21fbd5a86d1f2355996","Mirror","Performance - Local Load","Updated mirror design","Rear view mirror design adapts air flow local to the front of the sidepod and cooling inlets, giving a minor efficiency improvement.","Mirror | Performance - Local Load | Updated mirror design | Rear view mirror design adapts air flow local to the front of the sidepod and cooling inlets, giving a minor efficiency improvement."]

es.geometricDifference: Diseño actualizado del espejo
es.briefDescription: El diseño del espejo retrovisor adapta el flujo de aire local en la parte delantera del pontón y en las entradas de refrigeración, proporcionando una pequeña mejora de eficiencia.

monaco-2026-doc-15-audi-engine-cover-3.sourceKey: ["513eca62751dd9e24be31a313058e3efc949ad72ed25a21fbd5a86d1f2355996","Engine Cover","Performance - Cooling Range","Redesigned roll hoop and engine cover","For this event a new roll hoop and engine cover design are introduced to efficiently increase our cooling options.","Engine Cover | Performance - Cooling Range | Redesigned roll hoop and engine cover | For this event a new roll hoop and engine cover design are introduced to efficiently increase our cooling options."]

es.geometricDifference: Arco antivuelco y cubierta del motor rediseñados
es.briefDescription: Para este evento se introducen un nuevo diseño de arco antivuelco y cubierta del motor para ampliar eficientemente nuestras opciones de refrigeración.

monaco-2026-doc-15-audi-rear-wing-4.sourceKey: ["513eca62751dd9e24be31a313058e3efc949ad72ed25a21fbd5a86d1f2355996","Rear Wing","Circuit specific - Local Load","SM actuator removed","This design change aims to reduce any unnecessary blockage on the rear wing.","Rear Wing | Circuit specific - Local Load | SM actuator removed | This design change aims to reduce any unnecessary blockage on the rear wing."]

es.geometricDifference: Actuador SM retirado
es.briefDescription: Este cambio de diseño busca reducir cualquier bloqueo innecesario en el alerón trasero.

monaco-2026-doc-15-alpine-rear-wing-1.sourceKey: ["513eca62751dd9e24be31a313058e3efc949ad72ed25a21fbd5a86d1f2355996","Rear Wing","Performance - Local Load","Addition of winglets","As part of our ongoing in-season rear wing development programme, flap winglets are introduced at this event to further enhance aerodynamic performance.","Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | Addition of winglets | As part of our ongoing in-season rear wing development programme, flap winglets are introduced at this event to further enhance aerodynamic performance."]

es.geometricDifference: Adición de aletines
es.briefDescription: Como parte de nuestro programa continuo de desarrollo del alerón trasero durante la temporada, se introducen aletines de flap en este evento para mejorar aún más el rendimiento aerodinámico.

monaco-2026-doc-15-cadillac-rear-wing-1.sourceKey: ["513eca62751dd9e24be31a313058e3efc949ad72ed25a21fbd5a86d1f2355996","Rear Wing","Performance – Local Load","Updated wing section profiles and end plate geometry","Updated Rear Wing and End Plate surfaces to generate more aerodynamic load at the rear of the car whilst also improving sensitivity to changes in car attitude","Rear Wing | Performance – Local Load | Updated wing section profiles and end plate geometry | Updated Rear Wing and End Plate surfaces to generate more aerodynamic load at the rear of the car whilst also improving sensitivity to changes in car attitude"]

es.geometricDifference: Perfiles de las secciones del alerón y geometría de la placa lateral actualizados
es.briefDescription: Superficies actualizadas del alerón trasero y la placa lateral para generar más carga aerodinámica en la parte trasera del coche y mejorar la sensibilidad a los cambios de posición del coche

monaco-2026-doc-15-cadillac-exhaust-tail.sourceKey: ["513eca62751dd9e24be31a313058e3efc949ad72ed25a21fbd5a86d1f2355996","Exhaust Tailpipe","Performance – Local Load","Revised exhaust tailpipe and bracket geometry","Changes to the exhaust tailpipe and bracket geometry to increase local aerodynamic load and consequently improve the load characteristics at the rear of the car","Exhaust Tailpipe | Performance – Local Load | Revised exhaust tailpipe and bracket geometry | Changes to the exhaust tailpipe and bracket geometry to increase local aerodynamic load and consequently improve the load characteristics at the rear of the car"]

es.geometricDifference: Geometría revisada del tubo de escape y su soporte
es.briefDescription: Cambios en la geometría del tubo de escape y su soporte para aumentar la carga aerodinámica local y, en consecuencia, mejorar las características de carga en la parte trasera del coche
